description: A bearded man in a fur-trimmed tunic and dark cloak plays a violin-like bowed instrument in a stone hall with exposed timber beams. A harpist stands at the left edge. A fire burns in the centre with smoke rising and straw or rushes on the floor. A man in dark clothing sits in an ornate carved wooden chair, and a group of people in medieval dress watches from the right, including an older bearded man in red seated on a bench. Banners hang from the rafters and a shield emblem is on the wall. No legible text.

An artist should redraw it as a crwth, or confirm that a generic medieval fiddle is acceptable.
